_note: Recomputed from the cache by measure.py with no network. counts.json is the only input to build.py. Nothing here is imputed or modelled.

source.timezone: CET throughout, as the API states for its JSON door
source.provenance: The API's own interface description (UBA, 17 December 2025) says data of the current year are not finally checked and that final data are provided in June of the following year. 2024 was harvested on 2026-09-18 and is therefore the final series.
source.robots: robots.txt of luftdaten.umweltbundesamt.de was read before any data request; /api/ is not disallowed and that host states no crawl-delay. The www host it redirects from states crawl-delay 10; this harvester waited 12 s between requests.

law.instrument: Directive 2008/50/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 21 May 2008 on ambient air quality and cleaner air for Europe
law.annex_capture: Annex I, Section A - Data quality objectives
law.footnote: The requirements for minimum data capture and time coverage do not include losses of data due to the regular calibration or the normal maintenance of the instrumentation.
law.successor: Directive (EU) 2024/2881, which replaces it from 11 December 2026

two_doors.what: The same archive asked a second time: scope 3 (1SMW_MAX), the daily maximum of the hourly values, one number per station per day, against the hours the first door publishes for that day.
two_doors.daily_average_scope: Scope 1 (1TMW, daily average) serves nothing for NO2: the call that returns 388 stations for PM10 returns zero for NO2, checked 2026-09-18 for January 2024.
